How often your saved searches are checked for new jobs.
Searching more often than every 12 hours may get your internet address blocked by job sites. You may then see captchas or no jobs at all for days.
Search more often than every 12 hours?
Searching for jobs this often (%1$s) may get your internet address blocked by job sites. You may then see captchas or no jobs at all for days. Every 12 hours is the shortest we advise.
Stops ATS scores, company ratings and careers checks of jobs you haven’t opened, to free the computer. A job you open still gets them.
The app must run in the background to find new jobs.
Play a sound when new jobs are found.
Jobs the AI filtered out are deleted after the days below. Turn off to keep them forever.

Scan this code with the JobFinder Android app. The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as this computer.
The phone server is off. Connect this computer to a network, or pick a free port.

Save a search first. The sign-in browser then opens on its job site.
Already signed in to these sites in Chrome or Edge? With the JobFinder Helper extension, copy those sign-ins instead. Google sign-in works this way too.
